name: Fellow Ode Gen 2
details: Electric flat-burr filter grinder; settings 1–11 with sub-steps.

grindRanges.scale: numbered settings 1–11, with two sub-steps between numbers (5.1 = 5⅓, 5.2 = 5⅔)

notes.turkish: The Ode Gen 2 is a filter-only grinder.
notes.espresso: The Ode Gen 2 is a filter-only grinder and doesn't grind fine enough for espresso.

rangeInfo.note: Fellow's “Getting to know your grinder” guide for Ode Gen 2 (hosted by a retailer): Prismo 1–3, AeroPress 3–6, pour-over 4–8, cupping 6–7, electric coffee maker 7–9, French press 8–10, cold brew 9–11.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: moka pot: 1–3, the finest the Ode goes (Fellow's Prismo range); Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
